info.title: CodeMeridian Indexer - unified CLI for indexing codebases into CodeMeridian.
info.description: Unified CodeMeridian indexer CLI for C#, TypeScript/TSX, and documentation.

options.name: --project
options.description: Remove code graph nodes and documents for one project.

options.name: --all-code-graph
options.description: Remove all CodeNode graph data for every project. Documents are preserved.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project context name. If omitted, auto-detected from the target root.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Remove existing knowledge before indexing. Applied only once.

options.name: --include-diagnostics
options.description: Run diagnostics indexing. This is the default; kept for compatibility.

options.name: --skip-diagnostics
options.description: Skip project-native compiler, TypeScript, and lint diagnostics indexing.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be indexed without ingesting anything.

options.name: --list-capabilities
options.description: Show available indexers on this machine.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch mode. If both languages are present, C# watch runs first.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root directory to scan. Defaults to the shell's current directory.
